message: The selected 373-node optical density now maps exactly to the 186 x 186, 100 nm thermal cells by bilinear area integration. Constant and opposite-edge-wrap errors are zero, integral error is 4.483e-16, worst transpose error is 3.786e-16, and worst mapping FD error is 1.730e-13. The selected GPU Q artifact was partitioned by literal material overlap on the exact +/-9.3 um support and deposited conservatively on the 362 x 362 x 91 explicit 3D thermal grid. Total deposition error is 3.539e-16, worst component/material error is 9.190e-16, and no source cell lies outside its material. No Q was relocated or rescaled. Thermal gray-law solver AD-FD, the Maxwell adjoint, broader combined directions, exact-binary DRC fixtures, and full latent AD-FD still block optimization.
